name: us-market-insight
description: US Market Insight Android and iOS app. The bundle id is provisional until confirmed.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.test: node --test test/pure.test.mjs && node scripts/build-www.mjs && node --test test/bundle.test.mjs
scripts.android:debug: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.android:bundle: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease --no-daemon
